summary: fix(settings): stop pairing when the mobile browser is signed in
description:
Because:
- Pairing signs a device in to Sync, so a browser that already holds a verified account has nothing to pair.
- The v2 supplicant flow completed anyway, with no warning to the user.

This commit:
- Routes a signed-in supplicant to the pairing dead-end screen before the channel opens.
- Adds a signed_in reason and copy to the TimeoutAndCancel page.
- Lists the new reason in the Glean timeout_view extra description.

Closes FXA-14479
